value.rationale: The result determines a nontrivial local phase diagram for which oscillator partitions produce normally attracting discrete period-two clustering, including a universal strictly monotone analytic fraction and an exceptional network size three. It goes beyond the established generic period-doubling/cluster snapshots and provides exact transverse stability, a quantity governing robustness of cluster dynamics. It does not claim global attraction or basin sizes.
